translations.answer: To obtain net joint torque per step, enable joint force sensors and read the 'measured joint forces'; the maintainer also notes that the current API does not provide a way to isolate pure ImplicitDrive PD output from contact and other constraints, so log fields must explicitly state their physical semantics.
translations.applicability: Applies to the Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab interface corresponding to this Issue; re-evaluation is required after API version updates.
translations.credibility.rationale: Engineering records exist for the environment, processing steps, and results, but formal cross-validation or independent replication is lacking.
translations.details.attempts.0: The author attempted to use the 'actuation forces' and 'incoming joint force' interfaces.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: First, clarify whether the goal is to obtain net joint torque, joint force, or drive-only PD torque.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Enable DOF force sensors and read 'measured joint forces' when net joint torque is required.
translations.details.environments.0: Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab, Humanoid, ImplicitDrive, Joint Force Sensor.
translations.details.limits.0: Net joint torque cannot directly substitute for internal PD output in precise controller decomposition.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Pure PD output is still not publicly available via API; only net measured quantities including constraint effects are accessible.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: get_dof_actuation_forces always returns zero, and it is not possible to obtain pure ImplicitDrive PD output.
translations.details.safety_notes.0: The executor protection logic must clearly indicate whether it is using commands, estimated, or measured net force.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Interface semantics differ: get_dof_actuation_forces does not represent the internal ImplicitDrive output.
translations.details.symptoms.0: The opposing force is readable, but it is not the same physical quantity as the expected driveer internal output.
translations.source.title: Isaac Lab cannot directly read pure ImplicitDrive PD joint torque
translations.title: How does Isaac Lab read the actual joint torque generated by ImplicitDrive?
